checks.name: regression-suite
checks.command: cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-core -p truelearner-workstation -p truelearner-embodiment

findings: Runtime attachment now adds a whole sensor bank in one atomic body transition and is exactly equal to the same ordered single attachments, including checkpoint state and rollback on failure.

Dense incidence, physical-id, and vacant-slot indexes are derived body views: they preserve deterministic ordering, identifiers, observations, checkpoints, and logical Work while avoiding repeated whole-body scans.
Causal topology is projected only through connected components containing the requested outcome sources. The observable result and complete logical Work charge are unchanged.

Workstation and Academy checkpoints validate bytes once at the untrusted decode boundary, compose fingerprints without reserializing the owned core, and reproduce the exact next body-and-world transition.
Action-caused samples retain their action origin, passive or unchanged samples cannot fabricate one, simultaneous sensor incidence remains simultaneous, and construction remains inert.

Independent worlds from one frozen checkpoint are evaluated as a categorical product: development replay, learned probes, controls, and paired invariants may execute concurrently, then join in the original deterministic evidence order.

No modality, control, replay boundary, or advertised transition was removed. The full 12-transition release fixture passed in 0.30 seconds internally; the candidate runner measured 0.484 seconds including Cargo process overhead, below the 0.5-second requirement.
Ten consecutive warm measurements before handoff were 0.25 to 0.32 seconds, and the independent core, embodiment, and workstation regression suite completed in 0.84 seconds.
The plan, frozen neutral protocol, campaign arms, learner program, candidate receipt, formatting, compilation, and warning-free Clippy checks all validate.
residual_uncertainty: This receipt verifies the engineering candidate; it is not research authority and does not claim that the organism has completed the keyboard-selection ladder.
The frozen 64/64 discovery campaign has not been executed after this optimization. It must run once in the required fresh environment rather than using this dirty development tree.
Wall-clock timing is machine-dependent, so the fixture retains an executable release-only 0.5-second assertion instead of relying only on this receipt.
Future morphology growth can expose new connected-component or scheduler costs and must be measured from retained traces and Work rather than assumed away.
